adr039_lockstep_duplicates.reason: ADR-039 requires path_field_vector to apply the identical sqrtf(fmaxf(tx_power, 0.0f)) amplitude the field transport kernels apply to path_field, so the projected complex3 response and the scalar response remain the same physical quantity. The shared region is one expression, far below the 100-token gate threshold, so it is recorded here by hand; removing the duplicate would move the amplitude across the transport fusion boundary and requires its own numerical change.
